boundary: This adversarial test covers bounded English/Chinese condition, exception, concessive and contrastive scope forms around support/refute vocabulary. Generic if/when/as-long-as and 如果/若/倘若/只要 comma-delimited conditions verify that directional words inside a condition or its same-sentence main clause cannot manufacture unconditional closure. Explicit if...then and 如果/若/倘若/只要...則/那么/那麼 forms receive the same same-sentence containment even when no comma is present. English even if is explicitly separated from generic if matching: directional vocabulary inside the comma-delimited concessive subordinate prefix is contained, while an explicit directional main clause or later sentence remains visible. Chinese 即使 receives parallel adversarial coverage. This is lexical/structural scope containment, not general logical parsing or semantic discourse adjudication.
